content: University/campus CMMS needs: single digital intake queue across all buildings (mobile/web/QR), automatic routing by location+category+priority without manual dispatcher sorting, safety issues route immediately to supervisors, occupied-classroom issues prioritized over storage rooms, lab equipment routes to specialized technicians. Multi-building hierarchy needed: Campus > Building > Floor > Zone > Equipment, with PM template inheritance at each level. Mid-size university: 50-200 buildings, 15-50k assets. Reported gains: 30% productivity, 20% downtime reduction from automated routing vs manual triage.
